August 31st 1911—Dedication Day, Owen County Courthouse Opening
Responsibilities
The County Treasurer is a constitutional office and is the custodian of all monies belonging to the county. The Treasurer responsibilities include:
Billing and collecting property taxes (real estate, personal, mobile home)
Collecting taxes involved in bankruptcy
Collecting innkeepers tax
Issuing tax clearances for mobile home transfer/moving permits
Issuing tax clearances for alcohol beverage permits
Investing funds
Conducting annual real estate tax sale
Collecting delinquent property taxes and taxes in judgment
Searching for and collecting delinquent taxes of public employees

Payment Methods and Lender Information
Pay Online
To make a Tax Payment online, visit http://payments.municipay.com/in_owen/search/81d621f4
Online Payment Service Fees
Credit/Debit Card: 2.25% ($3.00 Minimum)
E-Check: $0.50 flat
Multiple parcels can be paid together
Pay by Mail
We accept personal checks, certified checks, and money orders. Make checks payable to the Treasurer of Owen County. Mail must be postmarked by the due date. Postmark does not mean the date printed by a postage meter that affixes postage to the envelope or package per IC 6-1.1-37.10. Returned, delayed, lost, or misdirected mail may become delinquent. Please ensure the mailing address is complete and accurate, obtain proof of mailing date, and use the correct amount of postage.
Mail property tax bills to:
Owen County Treasurer
PO BOX 600
Spencer, IN 47460
Pay at the Treasurer’s Office
The Owen County Treasurer’s Office is the collection agency for Owen County Tax Revenue. Office hours are 8 a.m. – 12:00p.m. & 1:00p.m. – 4:00 p.m., Monday through Friday. The office is closed to observe legal holidays. We accept checks, cash, cashier’s check, and money orders. Make checks payable to the Treasurer, Owen County. Credit card payments are accepted in the office but can also be made on-line. (See instructions above.)
The Treasurer’s office is on the first floor of the Historic Courthouse in downtown Spencer IN.
In-Person Payment Options
Credit/Debit Card: 2.25% ($3.00 Minimum)
Certified Funds: Cash, Cashier’s Check, Money Order
Personal Check
Dropbox
The Owen County Treasurer’s Office has a collection box located at the North doors of the Historic Courthouse for tax payments to be deposited. Items deposited in the drop box are considered as a timely payments unless it is deposited after midnight on the tax deadline date at which it is considered late.
Phone Payments
812-678-7599
For any issues or concerns, please contact Customer Support at 866-677-8053 for assistance.
Pay at a Bank- November 2nd thru November 10th 2026
The following Owen County Bank will accept payments of Owen County Tax Statements. You will need to provide your Tax Statement along with your payment. Bank locations outside of the County do not accept payment for County taxes. Banks may close earlier than the Treasurer’s office; please plan accordingly. Banks are not allowed to accept payments after the official deadline.
The Peoples State Bank (Spencer Branch Only)
812-829-2228
Lender Payment Information
New lenders wanting to set up payment files, please contact the office for more information.
The Treasurer’s Office has made a special effort to accommodate lenders and banks in such a way that individual taxpayers benefit as well. Please use the following resource:
https://lowtaxinfo.com
We also have public access terminals available on site.
Incomplete Information
For some of the properties you service, our records may not reflect that you are the lender. This means that property lists derived from our data alone may not be complete for your intended purpose. Please compare our data to your own to identify other parcels that you need to research.
